observations.observation: One line of ivory Korean serif type reads the title once; open counters, fine horizontal strokes and stronger vertical stems, straight baseline; title is much larger than body.

The complete two-sentence copy is set in four left-aligned lines. Body glyphs have regular widths and open counters; word spaces, two commas and final periods remain readable against the dark photograph.
The title is the main type anchor. Warm light, a glass boundary and the cropped coat/legs on the right carry the urban scene. The paragraph remains one connected lower-left block.
Sharp vertical window mullion, doubled street depth, localized glass smudges and warm reflected wet pavement create a continuous evening scene; the warm diagonal at the top is comparatively short.
Coat fabric, heel and trouser leg edges are quite sharp; the intended horizontal passing-reflection smear is not distinct from the blurred distant pedestrians.
Fine glass base edge and warm pavement reflection meet coherently; no ragged mask, extra watermark, logo or invented text is visible.

style.observed: Continuous photographic glass reflection/transmission scene with cool shadows and amber lights, crisp typesetting and cropped walking legs.
limits: Right foreground passer is predominantly sharp rather than horizontally smeared; the sharp/slow-motion contrast is weak.

substantive_visual.observation: The close glass surface, distant pedestrians, cropped coat/legs and reflected street lights communicate walking and noticing layered urban traces through one scene.

no_type_only.observation: Image depth, street action and reflected light organize the whole composition; no passive solid field with a subordinate tiny picture is observed.

hangul.observation: Title serif forms and body modern forms have mature proportions, stable baselines, open counters and visible word gaps. Photo blur is separate from typesetting.

information_relationship.observation: Upper-left title leads through the amber glass scene to the shared left-axis four-line paragraph; copy is not split into separate corners.

function_contact.applicability: No contact, hand action, URL or practical event data was requested. Faint existing glass marks are visible as scene traces.

material_edge_finish.observation: Glass mullion and lower pane edge are sharp, wet-ground reflections and out-of-focus distant people are coherent; foreground walking coat remains too crisp for the assigned motion expression.

flat_opaque_single_poster.observation: One full-frame opaque photographic poster, without mockup, frame or comparison panels.

residuals.limit: Horizontal motion smearing is insufficient; coat and legs look sharply photographed.
Dominant warm diagonal band is small relative to the large sharp vertical glass division.

decision.cause: Recover the assigned optical contrast: crisp glass and stronger broad diagonal reflected light against a horizontally smeared passing coat/legs.
maintain: Four-line connected body and shared left axis
